planets.name: TOI-178 g
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-178 with a 20.7-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-178 g was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around TOI-178. Its orbit and size follow Leleu et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
